title: Wrapping up the AX for Good session
description: This Friday evening, I wrapped up the AX for Good session.

spans.text: This Friday evening, I wrapped up the AX for Good session.

So many leaders came. It was my first time, so I was very nervous, but everyone stayed focused to the end and took an active part, and I am truly grateful. I also sincerely thank Yukwaehan Banran, MYSC and Uniquegood Company for setting up such a wonderful debut stage for me.

Earlier in the program, CEO Kim Jung-tae of MYSC and CEO Song In-hyuk of Uniquegood Company told the AI growth stories of their companies in the AX era. After them, I shared how to actually walk that journey, one step at a time: how to get meaningful results from today's most talked-about AI models, and beyond that, how Uniquegood Company uses AXIT in its day-to-day work. We also spent time trying it out together with all the participants!

During the session and after it, many people came up to say hello and ask serious questions. “Which AI model should we use?” “For an organization like ours, is it better to develop a platform like AXIT ourselves, or to use one?” The questions took different forms, but they all carried the same concern: what should we choose? To every one of those questions, in an AI era like this one, this is the answer I would like to give.

I think AX is AI Transformation and, at the same time, AI Experience. In an era when AI gets better by the day, you cannot judge what you have not experienced. Rather than rushing to a judgment, I recommend investing in that experience first.
I believe the answers to which model is best, and whether to develop your own SaaS or use an existing one, also come, in the end, from having actually used them.

Some people told me it was the most memorable and helpful workshop they had attended recently. Every one of those warm words gave me great strength. Thank you so much. Thank you for sitting through such a long session, and I sincerely hope this event became a meaningful first step toward creating new social impact.
I will prepare the next part of this AX workshop and come back to you soon. Thank you!
